text: Amazing diapers! Super soft on my newborn's skin. No rashes at all after 3 weeks of use. Highly recommend for new moms.
Best diapers I have used. Very absorbent, my baby sleeps through the night without leaking. Worth every dirham.
Great quality but a bit expensive compared to other brands. The tabs are easy to use and the fit is perfect for newborns.
Good absorbency but the tabs became stiff after some uses. Overall decent product for the price.
My baby got a rash after 2 days. Might be a sensitivity issue. Returning and trying another brand.
منتج رائع! ناعم جداً ولا يسبب أي تهيج لجلد مولودي. أنصح به كل أم.
جيد جداً من حيث الامتصاص لكن سعره مرتفع قليلاً. يستحق التجربة.
No leaks overnight. My 3 week old sleeps comfortably. The wetness indicator is very helpful for new parents.
Soft and gentle. The elastic waistband fits well without leaving marks. Slightly pricey but worth it.
Average product. Does the job but I expected better for this price. Tabs broke once.
Love these diapers! Very soft and the umbilical cord cutout is perfect for newborns. No leaks.
Good quality. Slightly less absorbent than Pampers but cheaper. Good value for money.
My go-to brand. Baby has no rashes and sleeps well. The stretchy sides make it easy to put on.
Had leaking issues after a few hours. Not as absorbent as I hoped. Will try a different size.
ممتاز! طري جداً ومريح للطفل. لا تسرب ليلاً. سأشتريه مجدداً بالتأكيد.
Best investment for a new mom. My baby loves it and my back does not hurt. Very adjustable.
Good carrier but takes time to learn how to put it on correctly. Baby sleeps well in it.
Quality is good but very expensive. Gets hot in summer. Baby seems comfortable though.
حاملة ممتازة! طفلي يحب النوم فيها. الخامة عالية الجودة وتدوم طويلاً.
Very complicated to put on alone. Instructions were not clear. Returned it.
